annotations.text: This artboard is live — click tiles to add or remove them from the carousel, and switch to HERO or THUMB to reassign those slots. The right rail renumbers and rewrites filenames as you go.

Slot geometry is lifted from ProjectPage.astro, not invented: A 8-col 16:9, B 4-col 1:1, FULL 12-col, C 5-col 4:3, D 7-col 16:9, FULL. Position decides the slot by default; a tile can also be pinned to one, which is a change that had to be added to Payload and the Astro page — it did not exist before.
Asset roots are editable at runtime and can point at a UNC share on the project NAS. An unreachable root is skipped, never fatal — the picker names what is missing.
Bracketed copy is placeholder — the parser fills these from the dropped .docx. Field names and the writeup [{paragraph}] shape match the Payload schema.
